label: Whatever is not MOTION_3 held as to being is PURE_ACT_1
paraphrase: Conclusion: whatever is not MOTION_3 held as to being (nothing other than it presently gives it being while it is in act as to being, definition ea1904bc-bdfa-4835-a4a7-8545c5221e2e at the respect esse) is in POTENCY_1 in no respect (PureAct of adopted potency, DEF-PURE-ACT, DEF-POTENCY). A fortiori a holder unheld in every respect is pure act. It is a claim about every being of the domain, not only about holders.
